1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

W.P.(C) 13559/2025 & CM APPL. 55577/2025 (Stay)
1. Having heard the counsel for petitioners at length, what can be noticed from the pleadings in the petition is the challenge to the Public Notice dated 31st July 2025 issued under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 ('Act of 2013'), with respect to the land described in the prayer clause.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner claims that, deviating from the scheme as prescribed under the Act of 2013, the Apex Court has fixed a schedule in exercise of powers under Article 142 of the Constitution of India, 1950 ('Constitution'), and the schedule should have been adhered to by the respondents.

entities.text: Lokesh Lochav & Anr. v. Govt. of NCT of Delhi & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. It is claimed that the impugned notice issued under Section 21 of the Act of 2013 is sans the schedule prescribed and, as such, attracts the consequences under Section 24(2) of the Act of 2013 for not completing the acquisition proceedings within schedule.

6. It is the contention of the counsel for petitioners that the schedule, since it is in deviation from the statutory provisions, i.e. Act of 2013 and is fixed in exercise of powers under Article 142 of the Constitution, has a mandatory effect and, as a sequel, the notice under Section 21 of the Act of 2013 stands vitiated.
7. Issue notice to the respondents.

Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Standing Counsel for respondent nos.
1 and 2 accepts notice on behalf of LAC/L&B/GNCTD.

8. Issue notice to the remaining respondent, returnable on 22nd September 2025.
9.

We make it clear that no further action pursuant to the notice under Section 21 of the Act of 2013,
as against the land of the petitioner, be undertaken till returnable date.
10. The aforesaid injunction order is passed taking in view the prima facie satisfaction by this Court that the schedule as ordered by the Apex This is a digitally signed order.
